These files contain only fabricated conversion markers and a plain colored image. They were generated with openpyxl 3.1.5, python-pptx 1.0.2 and Pillow 12.3.0. Core author metadata is synthetic. The empty files and image-only presentation verify that generated headings and image placeholders are not accepted as extracted document text.

The image_requirement files have a readable cover and a separate image containing only the fabricated SIEM requirement. They demonstrate why strict Office assessment must reject unassessed images.
